pairs: Et venerunt Ziphæi ad Saul in Gabaa,
And the Ziphites went to Saul at Gibeah,
Ecce David absconditus est in colle Hachila,
“Behold, David is hidden on the hill of Hachilah,
and he descended into the desert of Ziph,
et cum eo tria millia virorum de electis Israël,
and with him three thousand elect men of Israel,
ut quæreret David in deserto Ziph.
so that he might seek David in the desert of Ziph.
Et castrametatus est Saul in Gabaa Hachila,
And Saul encamped at Gibeah on Hachilah,
quæ erat ex adverso solitudinis in via:
which was opposite the wilderness on the way.
But David was living in the desert. Then,
Videns autem quod venisset Saul post se in desertum,
seeing that Saul had arrived after him in the wilderness,
et didicit quod illuc venisset certissime.
and he learned that he certainly had arrived in that place.
et venit ad locum ubi erat Saul:
and he went to the place where Saul was.
cumque vidisset locum in quo dormiebat Saul,
And when he had seen the place where Saul was sleeping,
and Abner, the son of Ner,
et Saulem dormientem in tentorio, et reliquum vulgus per circuitum ejus,
and Saul sleeping in a tent, and the remainder of the common people all around him,
David spoke to Ahimelech, the Hittite,
et Abisai filium Sarviæ fratrem Joab,
and to Abishai, the son of Zeruiah, the brother of Joab,
Quis descendet mecum ad Saul in castra?
“Who will descend with me to Saul in the camp?”
Venerunt ergo David et Abisai ad populum nocte,
Therefore, David and Abishai went to the people by night,
et invenerunt Saul jacentem et dormientem in tentorio,
and they found Saul lying down and sleeping in the tent,
et hastam fixam in terra ad caput ejus:
with his spear fixed in the ground at his head.
Abner autem et populum dormientes in circuitu ejus.
And Abner and the people were sleeping all around him.
Conclusit Deus inimicum tuum hodie in manus tuas:
“God has enclosed your enemy this day in your hands. Now therefore,
nunc ergo perfodiam eum lancea in terra semel,
I will pierce him with my lance, through to the ground, once,
and there will not need to be a second.”
quis enim extendet manum suam in christum Domini,
For who may extend his hand against the Christ of the Lord,
unless the Lord himself will strike him,
aut dies ejus venerit ut moriatur,
or unless his day to die will have arrived,
or unless, descending into battle, he will perish,
propitius sit mihi Dominus ne extendam manum meam in christum Domini.
may the Lord be gracious to me, so that I may not extend my hand against the Christ of the Lord.
Nunc igitur tolle hastam quæ est ad caput ejus,
Now therefore, take the spear that is at his head,
And so, David took the spear,
et scyphum aquæ qui erat ad caput Saul,
and the cup of water that was at Saul’s head,
et abierunt: et non erat quisquam qui videret,
and they went away. And there was no one who saw it,
or awakened, but they were all sleeping.
quia sopor Domini irruerat super eos.
For a deep sleep from the Lord had fallen over them.
And when David had crossed over to the opposite side,
et stetisset in vertice montis de longe,
and had stood upon the top of the hill far away,
et esset grande intervallum inter eos,
so that there was a great interval between them,
David cried out to the people,
that you would cry out and disquiet the king?”
et quis alius similis tui in Israël?
And who else is like you in Israel?
quare ergo non custodisti dominum tuum regem?
Then why have you not guarded your lord the king?
ingressus est enim unus de turba ut interficeret regem dominum tuum.
For one of the people entered, so that he might kill the king, your lord.
Non est bonum hoc, quod fecisti:
This is not good, what you have done.
vivit Dominus, quoniam filii mortis estis vos,
As the Lord lives, you are sons of death,
because you have not guarded your lord,
nunc ergo vide ubi sit hasta regis,
Now therefore, where is the king’s spear,
et ubi sit scyphus aquæ qui erat ad caput ejus.
and where is the cup of water that was at his head?”
Then Saul recognized the voice of David,
Quam ob causam dominus meus persequitur servum suum?
“For what reason has my lord pursued his servant?
aut quod est malum in manu mea?
Or what evil is there in my hand?
I beg you, my lord the king,
verba servi tui: si Dominus incitat te adversum me,
to the words of your servant. If the Lord has stirred you up against me,
let him make the sacrifice fragrant.
But if the sons of men have done so,
maledicti sunt in conspectu Domini qui ejecerunt me hodie ut non habitem in hæreditate Domini,
they are accursed in the sight of the Lord, who has cast me out this day, so that I would not live within the inheritance of the Lord,
Et nunc non effundatur sanguis meus in terram coram Domino:
And now, let not my blood be poured out upon the earth before the Lord.
quia egressus est rex Israël ut quærat pulicem unum,
For the king of Israel has gone out, so that he might seek a flea,
just as the partridge is pursued amid the mountains.”
For I will never again do evil to you,
eo quod pretiosa fuerit anima mea in oculis tuis hodie:
because my life has been precious in your eyes this day.
For it is apparent that I have acted senselessly,
and have been ignorant of very many things.”
Let one of the servants of the king cross over and take it.
Dominus autem retribuet unicuique secundum justitiam suam et fidem:
And the Lord will repay each one according to his justice and faith.
tradidit enim te Dominus hodie in manum meam,
For the Lord has delivered you this day into my hand,
et nolui extendere manum meam in christum Domini.
but I was not willing to extend my hand against the Christ of the Lord.
Et sicut magnificata est anima tua hodie in oculis meis,
And just as your soul has been magnified this day in my eyes,
sic magnificetur anima mea in oculis Domini,
so let my soul be magnified in the eyes of the Lord,
et liberet me de omni angustia.
and may he free me from all distress.”
Abiit autem David in viam suam,
And David departed on his way.
et Saul reversus est in locum suum.
And Saul returned to his place.
